description.en: Sets the outline ("silhouette") width and color drawn around a character or object, used for the highlight outline effect during techniques/training cutscenes.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Give the ball its silhouette outline for a technique cutscene
CMND_SET_CHARA_SIL_WIDTH(ahBall[i], EV_BALL_SIL_WIDTH, EV_BALL_SIL_COLOR);
